NATIVE CONTROL CONTRACT / EXACT PARAMETER REGISTER
TIC-101: PV source TI-101; MV TIC-101.OUT; mode AUTO; SP 75; reverse
Output cascades to FIC-201; remote-SP range is declared by the slave sp_limits.
FIC-201: PV source FI-201; MV TV-101; mode CAS; SP 1533.1; reverse
LIC-101: PV source LI-101; MV LV-101; mode AUTO; SP 2; direct
TK-101: feed15 m3/h; bulk75 degC; level2 m; steam6 barg; native equilibrium computes required steam flow.
TT-101 = native TI-101 source of TIC-101.PV; FT-201 = native FI-201 source of FIC-201.PV.
LT-101 = native LI-101 source of LIC-101.PV. LI-102 is independent indication, never a voting input.
Valve .POS tags are measured stem feedback; controller .OP tags are demand, not the same observation.
Steam trap, piping elevations and valve failure positions (*) are conceptual engineering assumptions.
FC steam stops heat input; FL product avoids asserting an unmodelled automatic release on loss of air.
Conceptual only: relief, isolation, vents, drains, line numbers, insulation and equipment sizing omitted.
